page: Microsoft Azure NG32ads_V620_v1 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NGADSV620v1 server family. Powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs driven by an AMD processor. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

For acceleration, the server integrates a single V620 GPU with 30 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is provided via a 4889 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is designated as Premium Storage capable. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile presents a high-density storage and GPU configuration paired with a relatively low memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:2. This makes the server highly suitable for GPU-accelerated tasks, graphics rendering, and storage-intensive workloads, though it may be constrained for memory-bound applications.
